# balena_service_label (Data Source)

Reads the one service label (the `service_label` resource of the `/v7` API) that matches every configured attribute. At least one attribute must be set, and exactly one row must match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "balena_service_label" "example" {
  id = 123456
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the service label. Selects the row when configured.
- `label_name` (String) API field `label_name` (short text). Changing it replaces the resource. Selects the row when configured.
- `service_id` (Number) ID of the referenced `service` (API field `service`). Changing it replaces the resource. Selects the row when configured.
- `value` (String) API field `value` (text). At most 300 characters. Selects the row when configured.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) API field `created_at` (date time).
